content:
With \(k\) steps, each pile can receive a subset sum of the \(k\) removal amounts.  
To represent all totals \(1,2,\dots,100\), we need at least 100 distinct nonzero subset sums, so

\[
2^k - 1 \ge 100 \implies 2^k \ge 101 \implies k \ge 7.
\]

The 7 amounts \(1,2,4,8,16,32,64\) can represent every integer from \(1\) to \(100\) as a subset sum. Therefore the minimum number of steps is

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
